architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

design_decisions: SVC-012 owns StressTestExercise (ENT-073) as the system executing risk model projections.
SVC-012 publishes EVT-161 (StressTestExerciseStarted) which triggers SVC-015 to create its RegulatorySubmission tracking record.
SVC-012 publishes EVT-162 (StressTestSubmitted) after CRO confirms PRA submission reference — this is the final event in the happy path.

consumed_events.name: StressTestExerciseStarted
consumed_events.purpose: Create RegulatorySubmission tracking record for PRA stress test. Set deadline from PRA calendar.

consumed_events.name: StressTestSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: Update RegulatorySubmission status to submitted; record pra_submission_ref and submitted_at.

design_decisions: SVC-015 owns RegulatorySubmission (ENT-074) as the compliance system of record for all regulatory submissions.
SVC-015 does not own StressTestExercise — risk model data stays within CAP-004. SVC-015 only tracks the submission lifecycle.

consumed_events.name: StressTestExerciseStarted
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable stress test exercise start record

consumed_events.name: StressTestSubmitted
consumed_events.purpose: Write immutable PRA submission record with submission reference

cross_service_interaction_summary: SVC-012 (CAP-004) → EVT-161 → SVC-015 (CAP-005): Cross-capability trigger for regulatory submission tracking
SVC-012 (CAP-004) → EVT-162 → SVC-015 (CAP-005): Cross-capability submission confirmation
Both events also consumed by SVC-103 (CAP-008) for immutable audit trail
